about: The MineRL project's models copied into runs/minerl/ (from ~/mineRL/runs/ in WSL). label: name in the reports; minerl_score: mean logs in the MineRL project's own evaluation (24 worlds, seeds 1-24, 1000 decisions = 4000 ticks, iron axe, ends at 64 logs); about: what it is. ppo_steps: PPO steps already in the model (its num_timesteps), so a fine-tune's own steps are counted from it.
